coverage_gaps: truck-evidence/src/fid/rep.rs: 4652-line emitter; read in full but the surface sliver/refinement/wrapped-adjacency algebra not exhaustively re-derived; no defect found
migration-only sites in truck-meshalgo, truck-stepio, truck-modeling, truck-shapeops spot-reviewed, per-site tolerance equivalence not proved

findings.summary: Sphere normal_cone under-encloses normals on azimuth-wide patches: corner-average cone half-angle 33.4 deg misses interior normals deviating up to 42.3 deg (probe: 31,702/40,000 sampled normals escape).
findings.spec_obligation: enclosure.rs:184 'A cone of normal directions over the box'; BG-ENC-001 no under-estimation
findings.witness: uu=[0.5,0.6], vv=[0,3.6] on the unit sphere; interior normal n(0.6,1.80) deviates 42.31 deg from the returned cone axis (half-angle 33.37 deg)
findings.reproduction: temporary probe against the crate (removed); probe output recorded in report
findings.consequence: future §9.1 transversality predicates certify a too-large minimal angle (false positive regularity)

findings.summary: Route-1 whole-span deviation certificate silently under-reports for degree-0 splines: the cut sub-piece hull omits the right-open endpoint value, certifying a bound of 2.4e-14 where the true deviation is 1.0.
findings.spec_obligation: deviation.rs:6-11 whole-span |deviation| <= tau for ALL t; feeds §1.1 invariant 4 same-parameter
findings.witness: degree-0 carrier knots [0,0.5,1] cps [(0,0,0),(0,0,1)] vs degree-0 leader cps [(0,0,0),(0,0,0)], span [0,0.5], tau 0.5
findings.reproduction: temporary probe against the crate (removed); half-span certifies, full span refuses
findings.consequence: same-parameter / pcurve-trace invariants can emit a certified within-tau claim that is false by an arbitrary amount

findings.summary: Wedge checker certifies WedgeNonDegeneracy on a NaN normal: a singular surface sample (cone apex) gives normalize()->NaN and NaN < sin_margin is false, so the edge is silently certified non-degenerate.
findings.spec_obligation: §1.1 invariant 9 wedge non-degeneracy bounded away from 0 and 2pi
findings.witness: edge midpoint mapped to a cone apex; search_parameter returns v=0, normal=zero, normalize()=NaN
findings.reproduction: temporary probe against the crate (removed); wedge::check returned OK on the apex-midpoint edge
findings.consequence: a knife edge / crack at a singular point is certified non-degenerate, voiding the §6.1 wedge term

findings.summary: Parametric Krawczyk center term is a single point at t_mid; strict containment of K_point does not prove 'unique solution in Q for every t in the cell', so the certified enclosure can under-estimate on non-monotone paths.
findings.spec_obligation: intersection_curve.rs:378-381 existence+uniqueness in Q for every t in the cell; enclose(tt) superset of the curve
findings.witness: 1-D analogue F(t,q)=q-(2t-0.6), cell [0,1], Q=[0.2,0.8]: K_point={0.4} certifies but true root leaves Q for t<0.4
findings.reproduction: code-level proof; 1-D witness machine-checked; not yet reduced to a failing run on the real crate
findings.consequence: IntersectionCurve::enclose under-encloses on non-monotone intersection branches; downstream deviation/fidelity consumers can under-report

findings.summary: RevolutedCurve::transformed silently returns the wrong surface under non-conformal affine maps (image of a revolution is not a revolution in general), and substitutes unit_z for a degenerate axis image instead of refusing.
findings.spec_obligation: Surface::transformed must return the transformed image; the analytic carriers are guarded, RevolutedCurve is not
findings.witness: revolution of profile (1,0,0)->(1,0,1) about z scaled by diag(1,2,1) returns the original circular cylinder (error 1.0) instead of the elliptic cylinder
findings.reproduction: subagent probe against the vendored crates (verified); direct path at canonical.rs:344
findings.consequence: scaled/sheared instances receive geometry that is not the transformed image, silently

findings.summary: sectional_curve v-cut decisions test p[0]/q[0] (u coordinate) against the v-knots: wrong section geometry on asymmetric boxes and a reachable panic (vcut at the back knot produces a degenerate surface). Pre-existing; in a changed file.
findings.spec_obligation: sectional_curve returns the section over the requested parameter box
findings.witness: box u in [0,0.5], v in [0,1] panics; box u in [0,1], v in [0,0.5] returns the full-v section
findings.reproduction: subagent probe against the vendored crates (verified)
findings.consequence: wrong section geometry or process abort for section consumers

findings.summary: wedge_slope_lower_from_sin_margin over-reports its certified lower bound at small sin_margin via cancellation in 1-sqrt(1-s^2): +4.4e-5 relative at s=1e-6, +49% at s=1e-8.
findings.spec_obligation: lfs.rs:4-10 a lower bound that may refuse more, never admit more
findings.reproduction: python evaluation vs series s/2+s^3/16+7s^5/512; machine-checked
findings.consequence: wedge-slope gate can admit a wedge whose certified slope bound is unattainable (small magnitude, unsound direction)

findings.summary: A single-face [e, e.inverse()] degenerate shell is certified Closed with CoedgePairing and VertexLink true, and accepted by Solid::try_new: the checker suite certifies a zero-volume degenerate solid as a valid closed manifold.
findings.spec_obligation: §1.1 invariants 1-2 and Closed shell condition feed Solid construction and downstream arrangement
findings.witness: wire [e, e.inverse()] on one face: is_simple passes (vertex stream distinct), shell_condition==Closed, checkers OK
findings.reproduction: temporary probe against the crate (removed); all three checks returned OK
findings.consequence: downstream consumers treating CoedgePairing=True/Closed as a valid 2-manifold boundary proceed on degenerate geometry

findings.summary: Full-circle conversion to a rational NURBS produces a negative/zero-weight control point; subs at the antipode is NaN and include returns false for full circles genuinely on the surface.
findings.spec_obligation: Surface::include must answer circle containment; full circles are common boundary curves
findings.witness: full circle angle=2pi: middle control point weight cos(pi)=-1; non-rationalized w=-1; 4D eval at t=pi gives w=0 -> NaN
findings.reproduction: python evaluation of the conversion (machine-checked); subagent probe of the crate include paths
findings.consequence: closed-loop boundaries falsely reported not-on-carrier; enum vs direct include disagree

findings.summary: Cone declares v unbounded (double cone) but include/search_parameter recognize only the upper nappe; search_nearest_parameter returns the far-side point on the lower nappe.
findings.spec_obligation: predicates must be consistent with the declared parameter domain
findings.witness: cone.include(cone.subs(0.7,-3.0)) returns false; search_nearest_parameter(0.5,0,-3) returns distance 1.88 vs true nearest 0.89
findings.reproduction: subagent probe against the vendored crates (verified); mechanism is radial=|v|slope vs v*slope
findings.consequence: points the cone generates cannot be certified on the cone; nearest-parameter queries on the lower nappe return wrong points

findings.summary: Torus normal_uder returns a wrong z-component (sin v instead of 0); it is not the u-derivative of normal. Pre-existing; in a changed file; feeds the fillet Newton solve.
findings.witness: d/du (cos v cos u, cos v sin u, sin v) has z=0; code returns sin v
findings.reproduction: finite difference at v=1: analytic z 0.841 vs FD z 0.0
findings.consequence: rolling-ball fillet Newton on torus faces solves with a wrong derivative

findings.summary: Reachable panics in the fillet approximation path (KnotVec unwrap on reversed range, mat.invert().unwrap on singular frames, sort_by partial_cmp unwrap on NaN) violate H-1. Pre-existing; in changed files.
findings.spec_obligation: H-1 no panics on data reachable from untrusted geometry
findings.witness: degenerate contact / reversed edge parameter range / NaN parameter
findings.consequence: fillet on degenerate geometry aborts the process instead of returning a typed refusal

findings.summary: Sphere::search_nearest_parameter(center) returns Some((NaN, NaN)) instead of None for a point with no nearest parameter. Pre-existing; in a changed file.
findings.spec_obligation: search_nearest_parameter returns None where no parameter exists
findings.witness: query at the sphere center: (point-center)=0 -> normalize -> NaN, wrapped in Some
findings.reproduction: direct: search_parameter(center) is None, search_nearest_parameter(center) is Some((NaN,NaN))
findings.consequence: nearest-point consumers can feed NaN parameters downstream

findings.summary: same_parameter certifies SameParameter=True vacuously when no pcurve is attached; Edge::pre_cut drops pcurves on both halves, so cut edges re-certify with no trace to check.
findings.spec_obligation: Prop::SameParameter = every edge use's parametric trace agrees with the leader over the whole span
findings.witness: Edge with PC=() after pre_cut: pcurve()==None -> vacuous_holds()
findings.reproduction: code reading; module doc admits the vacuous arm
findings.consequence: a consumer reading SameParameter=True as 'the trace agrees' is told so about edges whose trace was discarded

findings.summary: vertex_link certifies 'single cycle' from connectivity only; on open shells a connected link is a path, and the checker neither requires nor verifies closure (documented limitation, but the prop is the full invariant's).
findings.spec_obligation: §1.1 invariant 2: vertex link is a single cycle S^1
findings.witness: open single-triangle shell: singular_vertices empty, VertexLink=True
findings.reproduction: temporary probe against the crate (removed); also the module's own test asserts the open-shell hold
findings.consequence: over-states the checked property on open shells; the code's doc is honest about it

findings.summary: sphere immersion_lower_bound computes a lower-bound certificate with round-to-nearest f64 arithmetic, which can round up by an ulp; siblings use directed rounding via inari.
findings.spec_obligation: BG-ENC-003 outward rounding; a lower bound must round down
findings.reproduction: not demonstrated to bite; arithmetic direction is wrong by construction
findings.consequence: consumers certifying immersion from iota>0 have no formal guarantee (ulp-scale)

findings.summary: hyperbola/parabola containment predicates compare a model-space length (p-subs(t)).magnitude() against is_small_ratio (dimensionless); under a real model_scale the predicate loosens/tightens wrongly. Inert at Stage A.
findings.spec_obligation: BG-TOL-001: length comparisons go through is_small_len
findings.witness: magnitude() compared via is_small_ratio at model_scale != 1
findings.consequence: wrong containment answers on models whose scale differs from 1
